title: Patient Support & Adherence
short: Personalized medication education and follow-up that continues after the patient leaves.
problem: Counseling is short and patients forget most of it.
why: Poor adherence undermines diabetes, hypertension and asthma care.
solution: Turns counseling points into simple Arabic or English messages, reminders and check-ins that escalate concerns.

references.title: WHO — Adherence to long-term therapies: evidence for action

symptom: Patients forget how to take their medicine
directions: Starts after counseling. Sends simple reminders and check-ins; escalates side effects to the pharmacist.
review: A pharmacist reviews education content and handles every escalation.
